# J & M Power Washing and Holiday Lights

> Professional exterior cleaning and holiday light installation serving Rhode Island and southern Massachusetts. Family-owned, licensed, insured, with a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

## About

J & M Power Washing is a family-owned and operated exterior cleaning company based in Johnston, Rhode Island. We provide professional power washing, soft washing, and holiday light installation services throughout Rhode Island and southern Massachusetts. We are fully licensed, insured, and offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee on all work. Most jobs are completed in a single day.

## Contact

- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM

## Services

- [House Washing](https://www.powerwashjm.com/house-washing): Soft wash cleaning for vinyl, cedar, and all siding types. Removes algae, mold, mildew, and dirt safely without damaging surfaces.
- [Roof Cleaning](https://www.powerwashjm.com/roof-cleaning): Soft wash roof treatment to remove black streaks (Gloeocapsa Magma), moss, and lichen. Extends roof lifespan.
- [Deck Cleaning & Restoration](https://www.powerwashjm.com/deck-cleaning): Professional deck cleaning, brightening, staining, and restoration for wood and composite decks.
- [Concrete & Driveway Cleaning](https://www.powerwashjm.com/concrete-cleaning): Pressure washing for driveways, walkways, patios, and all concrete/paver surfaces.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://www.powerwashjm.com/gutter-cleaning): Complete interior and exterior gutter cleaning to prevent water damage and remove tiger striping.
- [Holiday Light Installation](https://www.powerwashjm.com/holiday-lights): Professional Christmas light and holiday lighting design, installation, in-season maintenance, takedown, and off-season storage. Commercial-grade energy-efficient LED lights, custom-fit roofline lighting, lit trees and shrubs, illuminated wreaths and garlands. Non-damaging roof clips (no staples or nails). $2M+ liability coverage. Residential and commercial properties. Serving 25 Rhode Island towns.
- [Fleet Washing](https://www.powerwashjm.com/fleet-washing): Commercial fleet and vehicle washing services for businesses.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://www.powerwashjm.com/commercial): Exterior cleaning for commercial properties, storefronts, and businesses.
- [HOA & Condo Cleaning](https://www.powerwashjm.com/hoa-condo-cleaning): Specialized exterior cleaning services for HOA communities and condominium complexes.
